title: Released Room Nights in Group Room Blocks Cancellation Damages
content:
When a Group Room Blocks contract is cancelled after room nights went back to general inventory at its cut-off, the released part of the chargeable room nights is the room nights of the block's cut-off release entries, never more than the chargeable room nights that remain once any nights excluded from the charge are taken off. The released part counts at the release share, which follows how long the released room nights have been back in general inventory:

| Block ledger | Signed notice received | Release share |
|---|---|---|
| carries a cut-off release entry | at least 14 calendar days after the cut-off date | 0.25 |
| carries a cut-off release entry | fewer than 14 calendar days after the cut-off date | 0.5 |
| carries no cut-off release entry | — | one |

Chargeable room nights outside the released part are not weighted by the release share.

**Records read.** The block ledger's release entries with the cut-off basis and the room nights they carry (releases with the cancellation basis are not cut-off release entries), the block's cut-off date, and the date the signed notice is received.

### Worked shares (hypothetical block with a cut-off release entry of 60 room nights, chargeable room nights 200)

| Notice received after the cut-off date | Release share | The released 60 room nights count as |
|---|---|---|
| 20 days | 0.25 | 15 |
| 14 days | 0.25 | 15 |
| 13 days | 0.5 | 30 |

With chargeable room nights of only 40 remaining, the released part is 40, not 60, and at a share of 0.25 counts as 10.
